title: SEC3: now2=1_000_000_000 comment says 'far future' but it is 2001
description: harness.rs:725: let now2: i64 = 1_000_000_000; with comment 'far future'. Unix timestamp 1_000_000_000 is 2001-09-09 — 25 years in the past (project date: 2026). The magic value works only because the backoff ceiling in outbox_tick is less than (1_000_000_000 - 1_000_000) = 999_000_000 seconds. That invariant is unstated: if the backoff policy changes the test silently breaks with no diagnostic. The fix is either (a) a named constant with a comment referencing the backoff ceiling (e.g. PAST_FAR_ENOUGH_FOR_ANY_BACKOFF), or (b) computing now2 = now + MAX_BACKOFF_SECS + 1 using the same constant the implementation uses.
